Welcome to %1$s! This replaces Android\'s screen rotation, so don\'t use the normal Android screen rotation settings.
There are two modes: %1$s and Locked. To see which mode you\'re using, look at the notification icon in the notification drawer.
To change mode, press the button in the notification. You can also make a home screen shortcut to do this.
%1$s mode is the same as Android\'s screen rotation, but if %2$s thinks you\'re sideways, the screen will face sideways.
Your orientation (whether you\'re lying down or upright) is also tracked and shown in the notification.
To change your orientation, either use Locked mode or use the %1$s and %2$s buttons in the notification.

%1$s might not work when an app is open that controls the screen orientation, such as YouTube. When this happens, the notification icon will show your orientation instead of the current mode. You can prevent apps from doing this by using the \"%2$s\" setting.
To prevent the screen orientation being stuck when you uninstall, use the \"%1$s\" menu item on %2$s\'s main screen.

• If the screen faces the wrong way:
 	1. Ensure the app you're using isn't controlling the screen.
 	2. Use the %1$s and %2$s buttons in the notification to correct it.
 • If this app crashes, please press the "Report" button so I can fix the problem.
 • If you have any feedback, you can send it from the store listing or the menu in this app.
